Select chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name). Join molecule_dictionary INNER JOIN drug_mechanism on molregno, INNER JOIN compound_structures on molregno, LEFT JOIN target_dictionary on drug_mechanism.tid. Filter molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4 and canonical_smiles is not null. Return DISTINCT rows. Sort by all eight output columns.
